items.hed: Texans fell 13-16 at Carolina; 53-man roster is due tonight
items.insight: Carolina’s club site has Friday at Bank of America Stadium final, Panthers 16, Texans 13. Starters sat. Marc Vandermeer writes the 53-man roster is due Sunday, and the games that count start Sept. 13 at home against Buffalo. Houston’s transactions page still shows no Sunday cut list as of 4:20 p.m. ET.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Venue still, not a game photo.

items.hed: Astros and Mets are tied 2-2 in the fourth at Citi Field
items.insight: MLB lists Houston 68-68 entering Sunday. The series finale at Citi Field is in progress, Astros 2, Mets 2 in the bottom of the fourth as of 4:20 p.m. ET. Saturday finished Mets 6, Astros 2. Friday Houston won 3-1.
items.image_caption: Minute Maid Park / Daikin Park, 2010 offseason. Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0. Venue still.

items.hed: Rockets open at home vs. Dallas on Oct. 21
items.insight: The published slate still stands: regular season opens Oct. 21 at home against Dallas, then San Antonio at Austin’s Moody Center Oct. 23. Twenty-one national-TV games. Preseason China Games vs. Dallas Oct. 9 and 11.
